name: greenfield-idea-to-intent
prompt: We are building a lightweight engineering document manager. Engineers need to find technical files, continue recent work, review changes, and know what needs attention. Create the upstream product intent for an MVP.
must: express user intentions as outcomes rather than UI actions
avoid inventing navigation or screen composition

name: reconstruct-existing-product
prompt: This existing app has Projects, Recent, Search, Reviews, Settings and a document editor. Reconstruct the product intent before we redesign its information architecture. There is little user research.
must: treat current UI as implementation evidence, not proof of user intent
avoid preserving every current destination as a justified capability

name: feature-request-challenge
prompt: Add an AI Summary page to the product intention map because stakeholders asked for it.
must: ask what user intention/outcome the capability serves or mark that link as unsupported
avoid automatically turning the requested page into a product intention

name: negative-trigger-local-ui
prompt: Make the sidebar spacing tighter and reduce the icon size.
must: recognize this is not product-intent work
must_not: create or modify an intention map
